title: EXPLAIN — Spark SQL reference (Apache Spark documentation)

claims.text: EXPLAIN compiles and optimizes a query without executing it, which makes plan inspection a safe diagnostic to run against production tables.

EXPLAIN EXTENDED prints the four stages of Catalyst's compilation in order — the parsed logical plan with names still unresolved, the analyzed plan with relations and attributes bound to real typed objects, the optimized logical plan after rule-based rewrites, and the physical plan — so the four-phase optimizer pipeline is directly observable rather than theoretical.

Spark's EXPLAIN offers five modes: default prints the physical plan alone, EXTENDED prints all four plans, FORMATTED prints a physical plan outline plus per-node detail blocks, COST prints the logical plan annotated with node statistics where available, and CODEGEN prints the generated code alongside the physical plan.

Because COST mode surfaces the row-count and size statistics attached to plan nodes, it is the mode that explains why the optimizer chose a given join strategy, whereas FORMATTED is the mode to learn plan reading on and CODEGEN is how whole-stage fusion is verified.
